events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 years since his death
events.blurb: On this day, hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, passing away six days later at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: 30 years ago, we lost a true icon. Tupac Shakur's music and message continue to resonate. What's your go-to track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 years since his passing
events.blurb: It's 56 years since the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix tragically passed away at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, 56 years on. His guitar changed everything. What's your favourite Hendrix moment?

events.title: Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic album 'Abbey Road' was released 57 years ago today.

angles.name: Iconic Abbey Road
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks… pure magic. Still walking across that zebra crossing in our minds.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary frontwoman of The Pretenders, Chrissie Hynde.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude are timeless. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the iconic voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: Imagine: 51 years since its UK single release
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK 51 years ago today.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' became a UK single. Its message of peace and unity is as relevant today as ever. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: 25 years ago, Apple introduced the first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod's Impact
angles.copy: Remember the first time you held an iPod? 25 years ago, it changed music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the anniversary of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007? Shaken, not stirred, naturally.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the indelible legacy of John Lennon. His music still inspires millions. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedic genius, writer, and actor John Cleese.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What hidden gem on this record do you love?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 years since his passing
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost a true showman, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released 61 years ago today.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: 61 years of 'Rubber Soul'! The Beatles truly evolved with this album. What's your favourite track from this folk-rock masterpiece?
